meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 15 — Expanded international economic architecture: additional FTAs/CEPAs, BIT network, and key bilateral frameworks beyond the earlier ASEAN/RCEP core.

candidates.title: Indonesia–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (IJEPA)
candidates.description: Indonesia’s first bilateral EPA. Covers goods, services, investment and capacity building. Continuously cited in Japan–Indonesia trade and investment analysis.
referenced_by: Foreign trade and FDI statistics (Japan partner share)
candidates.notes: Foundational bilateral EPA node with Japan.

candidates.title: ASEAN–Australia–New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (AANZFTA)
candidates.description: Multilateral FTA between ASEAN and Australia/New Zealand covering goods, services and investment. Part of the broader ASEAN+ network.

candidates.title: Indonesia–Australia Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IA-CEPA)
candidates.description: Bilateral comprehensive partnership covering goods, services, investment and temporary movement of persons.
referenced_by: Trade and FDI statistics with Australia

candidates.title: Indonesia–EU Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IEU-CEPA)
candidates.description: Comprehensive trade agreement covering the large majority of tariff lines. Negotiations concluded; entry into force pending ratification (targeted around 2027 in recent reporting).

candidates.title: Bilateral Investment Treaty (BIT) network
candidates.publisher: Government of Indonesia / UNCTAD navigator compilations
candidates.description: Indonesia’s stock of bilateral investment treaties (in force, signed, terminated). Provides the legal infrastructure for investment protection and is continuously referenced in FDI and investor-state analysis.

candidates.title: Overall FTA / CEPA network overview
candidates.description: System-level view of Indonesia’s active and prospective free-trade and comprehensive economic partnership agreements (ASEAN, RCEP, bilaterals with Japan, Australia, EU, etc.). Organises the individual treaty nodes.
referenced_by: All individual FTA/CEPA and BIT nodes

candidates.title: Indonesia–Singapore comprehensive partnership framework
candidates.description: Dense bilateral partnership reflected in successive Leaders’ Retreats and numerous sectoral agreements (economy, investment, defence, energy, environment, digital, human resources). Singapore is also a top FDI source and FTZ-linked partner.
candidates.notes: High-density bilateral relationship node sitting on the Malacca approaches.

candidates.title: Indonesia expanded international economic-architecture meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from trade, investment-treaty and bilateral sources
candidates.description: Meta-node that expands the earlier ASEAN/RCEP core with IJEPA, AANZFTA, IA-CEPA, IEU-CEPA, the BIT network, overall FTA/CEPA overview and the Indonesia–Singapore partnership framework.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier ASEAN, RCEP, trade and FDI series
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the expanded international round.
